name: Tesla Mini Bot
description: Modular WhatsApp bot with persistent PostgreSQL auth storage. Requires an external PostgreSQL DATABASE_URL.

DATABASE_URL.description: Persistent PostgreSQL connection string. Required; dyno filesystem is ephemeral.

OWNER_NUMBERS.description: Comma-separated owner numbers in international digits-only format.

PAIRING_NUMBER.description: Optional owner phone number in international digits only; set once to print a WhatsApp pairing code in worker logs.

OPENAI_API_KEY.description: Enables AI chat, image generation, text-to-speech and transcription.

MEDIA_PROVIDER_URL.description: Trusted compatible HTTPS media download API.

MEDIA_PROVIDER_KEY.description: Key for the configured media download provider.
